scope: Offline controlled schema-inspired authored study of two questions sharing records. Not actual enterprise data, legal eligibility, physical safety, full OWL, or measured human review time.
sources: ERPNext e864addb6c367688d2b264f284c2dd9b9360a97d Item/PO Item/PR Item/QI/BOM/BOM Item schemas
Original upstream BOM test fixtures remain separate unscored illustration; no inferred generated IDs

time.format: ISO date only, no timezones in v1
time.validity: valid_from <= date < expires; expires date is excluded by authored policy, not inferred from schema standard

identity.key: (record_type, id); repeated same key is ambiguous even if payload identical
identity.part: (item_id,revision); no label matching or automatic sameAs
identity.linkage: Explicit order_line_id, inspection_id, certificate_id on receipt. One matching record per typed key required; no fallback from names or item_id. Receipt/order/inspection part+revision and facility must match; certificate scope checked separately. Missing reference or zero matches = missing; >1=ambiguous; exactly1=resolved. Link status is independent of content equality.

checks: quantity finite and >0 and <= order.remaining_quantity; both units exactly Nos; different units -> unknown, never convert
inspection.status exactly Accepted; Rejected -> violation; other/missing -> unknown
certificate matches receipt part/revision/facility and status Active, and is valid at received_at
receipt_policy.certificate_status: Active allowed; Inactive is violation; any other/missing unknown. Exact known mismatched scope is violation.
receipt_policy.aggregation: Resolve all3links first. Missing/ambiguous link -> unknown, do not inspect arbitrarily chosen row. With resolved links, definite violation takes precedence over other unknown checks, else unknown if any required value missing/invalid, else accept. Never treat invalid/missing numeric/date as violation.

impact_policy.target: Question supplies target part+revision and certificate_id, not inferred from receipt acceptance. All cases use same target as receipt.
impact_policy.candidate: Non-reflexive positive reachability from target to product via active component->parent edges, exact revision, any positive path. Visited set prevents cycles; a cycle returning to target does not make target a product candidate. Do not infer reverse edges.
impact_policy.edge_validity: active must be boolean; malformed endpoint/revision/active marks graph incomplete and excludes that edge. Duplicate edge IDs exclude all rows under that ID and mark incomplete. Valid unrelated edges remain.
impact_policy.candidate_outcome: observed path -> yes. No path and complete edge coverage with no malformed/ambiguous edges -> no. Otherwise -> unknown. Product output universe is explicit four products; complete means only this supplied universe, not real world.
impact_policy.recheck: Use shared_dates.impact_status total decision order; candidate no -> not_required, candidate unknown -> unknown. Current recheck never changes historical receipt acceptance.
impact_policy.candidate_no: recheck=not_required when candidate=no; candidate=unknown -> recheck=unknown, even if policy would otherwise exclude product.
impact_policy.precedence: Apply runtime_contract and shared_dates exactly; no alternative status/date precedence.
outputs: one path witness occurrence_id sequence per positive candidate
impact_policy.graph_completeness: impact_graph_completeness is complete iff component_edge coverage is exactly one boolean true and no malformed/duplicate-ID edge exclusions. Otherwise partial. Inspection/order/certificate coverage never changes this graph-only flag. Four unique products are mandatory input universe, not a claim about all enterprise products.

comparators.description: Independent Python exact joins, numeric/date policy and graph closure.

Same public runtime facts and authored policies. Explicit adapter exact-key checks and parsing; RDF active eligible edges; OWL-RL transitive relation for candidate reachability; SHACL constraints for receipt content. Shared adapter exclusions and final status aggregation disclosed, not attributed to OWL/SHACL. No external database.
Optional predeclared ablation direct component links only; same eligibility rules, no multihop closure; label ablation not full code baseline.

cases.development: 12 predeclared scenario families x2 depths(1 and3) =24 scenes. Each has1receipt,4products,3explicit receipt links. Product roles: reachable+required-policy, reachable+exempt-policy, unrelated, reachable+other-facility. Use opaque IDs unrelated to scenario labels. Depth applies target->first two reachable products; third reachable other-facility may branch at final node.
cases.missing_source: Delete required record/edge in authored source before projection; coverage false for affected table. Scorer retains design lineage separately, runtime never receives deleted fact or expected answer.
cases.retrieval_omission: Preserve original source edge but omit it from runtime projection, runtime coverage false. Do not give runtime an omission-type label. Treat source and projection omissions as separate scorer strata; indistinguishable runtime evidence may correctly give same unknown.
cases.reserved: Do not yet generate or call any cohort heldout. Reserve future12scenes after development implementation is frozen; protocol+generator+scorer review required. Existing retail610 untouched.

scoring.per_arm: 24receipt outcomes;72typed-link outcomes;96product-candidate outcomes;96product-recheck outcomes;24impact_graph_completeness outcomes. Whole-scene errors preserve all denominators.
scoring.reference: Separately authored expectation ledger based on frozen policy/source provenance, not importing runtime functions or model outputs. Freeze before executing arms. Unknown reference remains unknown; do not force binary truth.
metrics: wrong required and missed required rechecks
candidate false positive/negative only on reference-known cases with explicit universe
unsafe complete claims on partial source or projection
scoring.external_truth: Injected controlled full-source topology can support separately labeled synthetic full-source reachability. Evidence-sufficient policy agreement is primary; do not conflate omission abstention with external factual error.
scoring.runtime_scorer_boundary: Runtime receives facts, declared coverage, question, policy only. Exclude case family, origin fault labels and expectation ledger. Save outputs before offline scoring. Never repair from scorer. Keep construction/execution failures in denominator.
scoring.completeness: Unsafe complete = predicted complete when reference impact_graph_completeness partial, over24graph flags only. Missing inspection with intact edge coverage -> complete graph; missing/omitted edge with falsecoverage -> partial. No whole-bundle completeness claim.
scoring.recheck_matrix: Report full3x4 reference(required/not_required/unknown) by prediction(required/not_required/unknown/error) counts. Reference required predicted not_required is missed; predicted unknown/error is withheld-required. Reference not_required predicted required is wrong-required; predicted unknown/error is unnecessary withholding. Reference unknown predicted decisive is unsupported; unknown is appropriate; error remains separate.
scoring.branch_coverage: 24study scenes cover only declared12families. Other supported rules such as cycles, malformed/duplicate edge IDs, invalid intervals and missing status need separate authored software checks; not additional study observations.

limits.scope: No performance superiority claim from descriptive timing; one authored design and controlled strata not prevalence sample. Human labor and maintenance unmeasured.

next: Independent design reviews now; exact fixtures/expectations and implementation each require fresh review before checks/execution.

runtime_contract.rows: Every table is an ordered array of row objects, never keyed objects. Each occurrence has a unique opaque occurrence_id separate from domain id. Retain duplicate domain IDs as separate occurrences. Duplicate occurrence_id or invalid table container is whole-scene input error with all planned outcomes error; never drop denominator.
runtime_contract.product: Exactly4 product rows with unique(id,revision) and occurrence_id; product.id equals edge endpoint item identifier. Any duplicate product key or missing product identity is whole-scene error. Output includes product id and revision. Other duplicates follow domain ambiguity rules.
runtime_contract.question: receipt_id,target_item,target_revision,certificate_id,as_of; exactly1receipt in24scene scope. No case family or reference labels.
runtime_contract.rdf: Adapter retains multiplicities and resolves/excludes duplicate typed keys before constructing URI graphs. Occurrence identity and diagnostics retained; RDF set semantics must not erase duplicates.
runtime_contract.coverage: Exactly1 boolean complete per table. Absent/duplicate/nonboolean declaration interpreted incomplete, not assumed true.
runtime_contract.witness: One deterministic shortest simple path per positive product, tie-break lexicographically by occurrence_id sequence. Exclude inactive edges. Bounded BFS visited nodes, no enumeration of cyclic walks. OWL membership and separate witness extractor must agree; mismatch execution error, never repair answer.

shared_dates.valid: Strict YYYY-MM-DD valid calendar dates; missing/unparseable dates or expires<=valid_from make interval unknown in BOTH questions.
shared_dates.receipt: Valid interval outside received_at is violation; invalid interval contributes unknown. Other definite content violations retain priority.
shared_dates.impact_status: Only Active/Inactive recognized. For candidate yes and uniquely resolved certificate: requirement=false or known target/revision/facility scope mismatch -> not_required before date/status checks. Otherwise missing requirement or scope -> unknown. Then invalid interval/date or missing/unrecognized status -> unknown. Then as_of>=expires -> required for either recognized status. Else if valid_from<=as_of<expires and status Active -> not_required. All remaining cases -> unknown. This is an authored expiry-only rule, not legal policy.
